items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I had a lot of the fellas work with me. Bill worked a long time with me, Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: Did you ever have a real big band yourself?

Yeah, I did, most of the time. I had a lot of the fellas work with me. Bill worked a long time with me, Bill Matthews. Paggio, second trumpet. Mario Custer, played saxophone and clarinet, he's a nice trumpet player too, you know. Oh I had many of them played.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Willie Pajor and Bill Matthews, the way, with me and the big band.

ctx.x: I understand you have quite a collection of music, is that true? I'm not trying to put you on the spot and ask you everything that you know, but I just wondered, I mean I know that you're a musician that knows more tunes than almost anybody around, I understand.

I have up in the front there, a whole lot of music when I had the big band. Willie Pajor and Bill Matthews, the way, with me and the big band. And I have a lot of music. A lot of music. And when Professor John Robichaud died, his wife was Anna, she gave me quite a bit of music. You know what I mean? At that time.
I've had a couple of books of John Robichaud's too with his name stamped on that I got from Maurice Durand or something like that.
